children: TORONTO, Aug. 31, 2026 /CNW/ -- Celestial Acquisition Corp. (TSXV: CES.P) ("

") announces that it has terminated the business combination agreement dated April 15, 2026 among Nokia Solutions and Networks Oy, Nokia of America Corporation and Modulate Space Corporation. The parties were unable to complete the transaction and financing on terms acceptable to them in the current market environment.

Jared Bottoms, CEO of Celestial, said: "Although we are disappointed that prevailing market conditions prevented the completion of the transaction, we greatly appreciated the opportunity to work with the Nokia and Modul8 teams. We thank them for their collaboration and professionalism and wish them continued success as they advance innovative technologies and pursue their strategic objectives."
Celestial is continuing to identify and evaluate alternative acquisition opportunities in the space and defence sectors with a view to completing its Qualifying Transaction.
Celestial is in the process of seeking approval from the TSX Venture Exchange for the resumption of trading of its common shares.

Celestial is the first Capital Pool Company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange that is focused on the Space sector. Celestial is part of a larger platform and network of sophisticated technicians, industry professionals and impact capital whose mission it is to grow the Space Tech ecosystem in Canada by attracting exciting growth stage New Space companies to the Canadian capital markets, and supporting their growth and success.

Investors are cautioned that trading in the securities of a capital pool company should be considered highly speculative.
